notes.title: Bridge Constructor Studio announce for a PC release sometime this Summer
notes.notes: Bridge Constructor Studio is the latest in the popular series of physics building puzzlers from developer ClockStone. Originally launched for Meta Quest, they recently revealed a proper PC release is coming.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/bridge-constructor-studio-announce-for-a-pc-release-sometime-this-summer/
